about_the_game:
Battlement is a couch-co-op game where you battle your friends as an elemental warrior.

Burn, liquefy, electrocute or kill your friends with any of the elemental powers.

Here is what's included in the demo:

  • 2 warriors to fight your bloody battles

  • 2 maps to explore

  • 2 game modes to challenge your friends

Disclaimers

  • Warning: This game contains flashing lights that may make it unsuitable for people with photosensitive epilepsy or other photosensitive conditions. Player discretion is advised.

  • Only one player can use keyboard + mouse per computer. So playing locally requires controllers for the other players.

  • Battlement is a couch-co-op game. There is no singleplayer mode and no bots. Make sure to bring a friend!

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 LTS or SteamOS 3.0
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel UHD Graphics 630 or equivalent with Vulkan support
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Latest Mesa drivers recommended

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.13 High Sierra or later (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or Apple Silicon via Rosetta 2
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 6000 or better
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: (Demo) A couch-co-op where you fight your friends with elemental warriors that harness powerful magic. Choose to challenge your friends in the many game modes such as tag or duals, and slaughter them in unique places like PeaceGrounds or Castle's Edge. Fight with Honour!
